name: Heath Crescent
source:
[i]"Please, treat my life... as one of your possessions."[/i]

[i]Innocently Submissive[/i]

A housekeeper blessed with overwhelming beauty. Every day is busy, filled with handling Vy-xen's household affairs and serving multiple wealthy households for work.

He recognizes his own beauty as an unshakable truth, and perfectly wears the maid's uniform originally offered as a joke. His expression is always immovable and indifferent, and he harbors extreme disgust for the greed and depravity of humans. His Gift is nullification. He neutralizes all Grimnal attacks.

Even the walls of ice around him seem to slowly melt away in the heroine's presence. To her alone, he displays a pure devotion he's never shown to anyone else.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=heath]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
